title: Implement KHOSAN Multi-Project Workspace Architecture in Studio Shell
objective: Establish project isolation, Project Library, active-project switching and portable project manifests before Asset Lab and World Editor production expands.
acceptance_criteria: Project Library and active-project APIs are implemented
Studio Shell includes active project selector and project activation
New project creation initializes portable manifest, project state and isolated production directories
Project workspace endpoint exposes one write boundary and DevSpace root
Source verification checks the new contracts
verification: GitHub source inspection confirms required implementation files
JSON.parse succeeds for new schemas, feature list and Studio state
node --check passes for server.mjs and app.js
fresh local two-project smoke test remains required before acceptance
risks: Fresh local browser/API smoke test has not yet been run on the target PC
Filesystem picker/import of arbitrary external project roots is intentionally not exposed in v0.2 because the HTTP API must not accept arbitrary paths
Project schema migration UX is specified but not yet implemented
notes: v0.2 source implements library-root projects and switching. External-project registration, migrations, Asset Registry and World Editor remain later bounded features.
